title: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels: 'I'm feeling good' after injury-filled season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels: 'I'm feeling good' after injury-filled season
sources.description: Jayden Daniels 2025 season was shortened by a series of injuries, including a dislocated elbow. The Commanders QB gave us an update on his health.
